examples.text: The Romans counted it as from midnight, and most modern nations use this method.
examples.translation: 罗马人从午夜开始计算一天，如今大多数国家都采用这种方法。
examples.speechText: The Romans counted it as from midnight, and most modern nations use this method.

examples.text: That rising air spreads outward and sinks between 20 and 40 degrees north and south of the equator, and stops cloud formation—which explains why there are so many deserts along the subtropical belt (亚热带), such as the Sahara Desert.
examples.translation: 上升的空气向外扩散，并在赤道南北纬20至40度之间下沉，阻碍云的形成；这就解释了为什么撒哈拉沙漠等许多沙漠分布在亚热带地区。
examples.speechText: That rising air spreads outward and sinks between 20 and 40 degrees north and south of the equator, and stops cloud formation—which explains why there are so many deserts along the subtropical belt , such as the Sahara Desert.

examples.text: Her parents seem to have been rather withdrawn（withdraw的过去分词形式，此处作形容词） people, and the members of the family spent a good deal of time by themselves.
examples.translation: 她的父母似乎都比较内向，家人也有很多时间各自独处。
examples.speechText: Her parents seem to have been rather withdrawn people, and the members of the family spent a good deal of time by themselves.

annotations.text: （withdraw的过去分词形式，此处作形容词）

examples.text: He or she can diagnose the problem or refer you to a specialist.
examples.translation: 他或她可以诊断问题，或将你转诊给专科医生。
examples.source: （2019年配套材料·选句填空·完整句选项）
examples.speechText: He or she can diagnose the problem or refer you to a specialist.

examples.text: Marine pollution is far from new.
examples.translation: 海洋污染早已不是新鲜事。
examples.speechText: Marine pollution is far from new.

examples.text: You are there to study (an active process) rather than to be taught (passive).
examples.translation: 你来是为了学习（一个主动的过程），而不是被教导（被动）。
examples.speechText: You are there to study (an active process) rather than to be taught (passive).

examples.text: No matter how tough the situation is, smile!
examples.translation: 无论处境多么艰难，都要微笑！
examples.speechText: No matter how tough the situation is, smile!

examples.text: Cooper received（receive的过去式） an award there for his lifetime of work.
examples.translation: Cooper在那里因其毕生的工作成就而获得了一个奖项。
examples.speechText: Cooper received an award there for his lifetime of work.

examples.text: She would rather see the whole street redesigned to discourage speeding and protect walkers and bicyclists.
examples.translation: 她更希望整条街道被重新设计，以遏制超速行为，并保护行人和骑自行车的人。
examples.speechText: She would rather see the whole street redesigned to discourage speeding and protect walkers and bicyclists.

examples.text: Therefore, the structure of products should be adjusted accordingly to adapt to social development.
examples.translation: 因此，应相应调整产品结构，以适应社会发展。
examples.speechText: Therefore, the structure of products should be adjusted accordingly to adapt to social development.

examples.text: When you picture a desert, you probably imagine a vast, empty landscape far from any water.
examples.translation: 想到沙漠时，你可能会想象出一片辽阔、空旷、远离任何水源的地貌。
examples.speechText: When you picture a desert, you probably imagine a vast, empty landscape far from any water.

examples.text: Customers' containers are weighed first, then filled（fill的过去分词形式）.
examples.translation: 先给顾客的容器称重，然后再装入商品。
examples.speechText: Customers' containers are weighed first, then filled.

examples.text: This plant was severely punished（punish的过去分词） by the government for releasing pollutants into water.
examples.translation: 这家工厂因向水中排放污染物而受到政府的严厉处罚。
examples.speechText: This plant was severely punished by the government for releasing pollutants into water.

examples.text: You’ll not only save money, but you’ll also see a lot more of the country.
examples.translation: 你不仅能省钱，还能看到这个国家更多的地方。
examples.speechText: You’ll not only save money, but you’ll also see a lot more of the country.

examples.text: In reality, most people expect much less.
examples.translation: 实际上，大多数人预期的远少于这个。
examples.speechText: In reality, most people expect much less.
